title: Why AeroTopo does not use StringBuffer
answer: In this AeroTopo codebase, the text-building operations use local `StringBuilder` instances and there is no `StringBuffer` usage in `src`. Those builders are method-local and are not shared mutable state, so synchronized `StringBuffer` operations would not provide a correctness benefit for these cases. I would use `StringBuffer` only if one mutable buffer truly had to be shared across threads and synchronized method-level access was the right design. For local text construction, `StringBuilder` is simpler and avoids unnecessary synchronization.

steps.why_te: reverse method builder local ga create avutundi and method lo ne finish avutundi; Multiple threads same builder object share cheyyavu; StringBuffer synchronization requirement ikkada ledu.

steps.why_te: Each expandRuns call own StringBuilder create chestundi; Many requests parallel ga call chesina builders separate objects; Shared mutable buffer ledu kabatti internal synchronization avasaram ledu.
